title: Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans: Contract Form, Star Rating and Approved Capacity by Plan
content:
Every plan in the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans book is filed in one of two contract forms: a medical plan, or a drug-only employer group waiver plan. Each filed plan also carries the overall star rating most recently published for it by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, on the scale of 1.0 to 5.0, and a capacity figure: the greatest number of retirees that plan benefit package is approved to hold.

## Register of filed plans

| Group plan | Contract form | Overall star rating | Approved enrollment capacity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | Medical plan | 3.5 | 24000 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Medical plan | 4.0 | 17500 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Medical plan | 4.5 | 8600 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | Drug-only employer group waiver plan | 3.5 | 31000 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Drug-only employer group waiver plan | 4.0 | 21000 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | Drug-only employer group waiver plan | 4.0 | 9400 |

## Reading of the register

The contract form is a property of the plan the sponsoring group bought. The three plans whose names carry PPO are filed as medical plans; the three whose names carry EGWP are filed as drug-only employer group waiver plans.

The rating shown against a plan is the most recent overall rating published for that plan and for no other. Two plans of the book may stand at the same rating, as Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) both do at 4.0, and the highest rating in the book, 4.5, stands against Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) alone.

The capacity figure is approved for the plan benefit package. It is at its greatest on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP), at 31000 retirees, and at its least on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO), at 8600.
